title: athanasia crithmifolia subsp. palmatifida
intro: Athanasia crithmifolia subsp. palmatifida, commonly known as Chrysanthemum, is a plant species in the daisy family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Athanasia crithmifolia subsp. palmatifida include reducing fever, relieving digestive issues, and improving skin health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
